scope: Supplemental caller-declared choice record; existing provider receipts/source/request qualification remain authoritative

baseline_sufficient.meaning: Existing baseline observable answers the present question, including a scoped unknown explanation

conditional_s2.meaning: Explicit available-premise S2 proposal or saved conditional result; numerical UNKNOWN is still possible

save_s2_unknown.meaning: Legal explicit request or saved raw + UNKNOWN when optional count/geometry/width prerequisites are unavailable; required MCP fields still apply

retain_unknown.meaning: Retain observations and state missing evidence or seek a scientific revision without dispatch

research_only.meaning: Research history, without production dispatch or default promotion

recover_original.meaning: Read image_result using the exact original request ID; no new scientific write

notes: All fields are required, using explicit nulls where the record has no reference; null is not a guessed identity or a verified premise.

locator records the retained provider/workspace and session if known. prior_request has its original locator; a same-ID query or stopped unresolved write must retain that locator. These fields declare scope and do not authenticate it or inspect the filesystem.

Recovery or a stopped unknown/pending original write may have source=null or explicit nulls for unavailable source IDs/frame/ROI. Never fabricate placeholders to make recovery pass. New or saved measurements require full saved source IDs, frame and ROI; unknown calibration may remain null.
A supplied premise needs actual source_text but remains unverified. The checker cannot determine acquisition truth, shape adequacy, source closure or authenticated authorship.
width_shape supplied means the width/model declaration is provided. source_text may explicitly state that shape adequacy is NOT_ASSESSED; supplied never means physically verified.

A planned S2 request needs existing raw baseline evidence. A saved column-fit receipt may itself supply the raw baseline, represented by baseline_evidence.kind=column_fit_raw and the same saved object/request.

A missing optional count/geometry/width prerequisite S2 call is legal when required object/ROI/reference fields remain valid. Reference equivalence and shape adequacy are interpretation premises, not automatically verified worker gates. save_s2_unknown never labels that fit available. conditional_s2 can still save unknown due to numerical gates.

An unknown or pending original write blocks a new write; retain a stopped write or record a same-ID image_result query. A deliberate revision after completed/failed outcome uses a different request ID and revision_of_request_id equal to the prior ID.
Records and sidecars do not add an AnalysisContext role, Panel slot, provider journal or tool. Preserve source arrays, receipts and prior decisions.
